messages:
alina: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem. Consolidating action items: replication lag checks, manifest TTL, and clearer restore ownership. Reply with ownership and ETA.

matt: I'll take R-01 (replication lag alerting). Add a 5min rolling window and an auto-escalation if lag > 30s for 3 consecutive checks. ETA 2026-03-31, ticket OPS-7802.

hannah: I'll own R-02 (s3 manifest TTL & audit). Plan: verify manifests every hour and add TTL meta so old manifests are flagged. ETA 2026-03-28, job=JENK-1001.

peter: I'll handle R-03 (restore ownership doc). Add explicit owner handoff steps and mobile escalation for oncall. Draft doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/restore-owners ETA 2026-04-04.

alina: propose short drill schedule: tabletop 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC, warm failover eu-west 2026-04-18 14:00 UTC. ops-bot: event created -> "DR tabletop" 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC (organizer: alina)

matt: small config snippet I'll include in the RFC:
```bash
# replication alert example
monitor lag_ms > 30000 for 3m then notify #oncall
```

hannah: will tag telemetry with failure_mode=manifest-missing to track recurrence and add a weekly digest to #incidents.

peter: adding a pre-restore checklist to prevent cross-team confusion: confirm manifest, kms access, and who will drive VIP rebind.

alina: action tracker snapshot: R-01 owner=matt ETA=2026-03-31 OPS-7802; R-02 owner=hannah ETA=2026-03-28 JENK-1001; R-03 owner=peter ETA=2026-04-04 doc link above. Please update here as you progress.

matt: ack

hannah: ack

peter: ack

alina: closing thread for now. I'll post a Monday roundup until items are closed.
